     Liquid tar.

     Introduced by Jeanes.

   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Pix]
Expectoration of purulent matter, offensive in odor and taste and accompanied by pain, referred to third costal cartilage (really in left bronchus) ; pain may or may not go through to back. θ Bronchial catarrh. θ Phthisis.
Useful in third stage of phthisis.
Pain at third left costal cartilage, where it joins with rib ; rales through lungs and muco-purulent sputa. θ Phthisis.
Suppurative processes affecting left lung, with pain at third left costal cartilage.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Pix]
Pain : in left third costal cartilage.
Intolerable itching : of eruption on hands.
   

SKIN. [46] [Pix]
Eruption, especially on backs of hands, itching intolerably at night and bleeding when scratched.
Violent itching.
Skin cracked, bleeding when scratched, with sleeplessness.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Pix]
Compare Anisum stellatum in chest pains.
